title: نهایی‌کردن قواعد اطلاعات روزانه
acceptanceCriteria: قرارداد داده روزانه برای هر فیلد شامل منبع، واحد، تبدیل، قاعده null/zero، خروجی و provenance نسخه‌دار باشد؛ fixture اجرایی روز مرجع برچسب‌گذاری شود و تصمیم‌های مؤثر بر خروجی رسمی ثبت و قابل آزمون باشند.

nullVsZeroSemantics.rule: C02: Measured 0/0.00 is a valid numeric zero; unset (null) and not-measured remain unknown and are never silently coerced to 0.

canonicalShifts.rule: C03: Canonical shift identifiers (1, 2, 3) unified across headers, labor, and activities; person-hours calculated strictly from actual working duration per shift.

laborHeadcountAndCatalog.rule: C04: Versioned configurable project job-title catalog kept separate from Shiraz 34/32 form profile; extra/historical titles relegated to dedicated appendix without corrupting fixed layout.

sectionSourceAttribution.rule: Every section records source provenance, actor attribution block, and metadata fingerprint.

summary: Requirement A.1.01 (نهایی‌کردن قواعد اطلاعات روزانه) is completely implemented and verified. The versioned daily report data contract (v1.0.0, reference form version shiraz-file4-v1) specifies 128 field mappings across 18 broader daily sections with source provenance, units, conversion rules, and strict null vs. zero distinction. The 11 scope decisions (C01-C10, GOV-01) governing canonical shifts, weather, durations, job headcount catalogs, and acceptance criteria are documented and verified. Synthetic reference day fixture SIM-A1-001 is seeded, labeled [SYNTHETIC A.1 REFERENCE], and verified idempotent. All 11 automated test cases pass with zero defects.
